findings.detail: `read-only` exists in 12 namespaces with 2 different bodies — copies have drifted; 1 differs from the most common one.

findings.title: Same-named Sentinel policy differs across namespaces

findings.title: Sentinel policy is advisory
findings.detail: Enforcement level is `advisory` — the policy logs violations but never blocks a request.

findings.title: Sentinel policy always evaluates true
findings.detail: Policy body always evaluates to true — it enforces nothing despite appearing in the policy list.

findings.title: Sentinel policy makes outbound HTTP calls
findings.detail: Imports `http` — each request it applies to can wait on an outbound call, so that endpoint's availability and latency gate Vault requests.

findings.title: Sentinel policy is overridable
findings.detail: Enforcement level is `soft-mandatory` — a caller with a `sudo`-capable token can override it.

findings.title: EGP applies to every path
findings.detail: Endpoint path is a wildcard — the policy applies to every request in this namespace.
